'''Stygium''' was a type of [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]] only found on [[Aeten II/Legends|Aeten II]].

==Uses==
===Stygium crystal cloaking device===
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] passed a law controlling the trade of stygium, as it was a crystal that, when used properly, could entirely [[Cloaking device/Legends|cloak]] a vehicle. In the Galactic Republic's early years these devices were common, since Aeten II held an abundance of them. These vehicles included the [[Scimitar/Legends|''Scimitar'']], [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul's]] ship, which carried an array of stygium crystals in its long prow.

[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] secret apprentice, codenamed [[Galen Marek|Starkiller]], utilized stygium crystals in his ship, the ''[[Rogue Shadow]]'', which used a cloaking device.

During the events from the capture of the [[Tantive IV/Legends|''Tantive IV'']] to the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Martio Batch]] sent an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] superweapon to Aeten II, the [[Tarkin (superweapon)|''Tarkin'']]. There, the ''Tarkin'' blew open the planet to reveal its stygium core. Using the crystals and the original stygium implementation, he started the [[TIE/ph "Phantom" Multi-Role Stealth Starfighter/Legends|Phantom TIE project]]. However, saboteurs from the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] destroyed the project and Batch fled.<ref name="SWI66">{{InsiderCite|66|Who's Who: Imperial Grand Admirals}}</ref>

There was also an entire island on [[Maramere]] composed of the crystals, which made it invisible to scanners. Since the island was also covered with the fog surrounding the [[Haunted Straits|Haunted Strait]], the island was also invisible to the eye, making it the perfect hideout for [[Sol Sixxa]].

===Stygium lightsaber crystal===
In its pure crystal form, it was known to be suitable for use as a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] crystal. It was known that when refined Stygium was mounted on a personalized lightsaber and wielded by a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]], the natural cloaking attributes of the crystal would augment the power of a stealth-minded Jedi in remaining unseen.

==Behind the scenes==
In order to corrupt Aeten II in ''[[Star Wars: Empire at War: Forces of Corruption]]'', the player can select the mission "[[Pirate/Legends|Piracy]]" to begin a battle involving [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]] and a small [[Zann Consortium/Legends|Zann Consortium]] fleet destroying some Stygium Crystal containers. This allows the player to build [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE Defenders]] for the Zann Consortium.
